item.title: Iran fires more missiles at Israel and rejects Trump's talk as 'fake news' for markets
item.summary: Israeli health officials said Iranian missiles struck four sites across Israel Tuesday, including central Tel Aviv, injuring at least six people. Iranian authorities also said a gas supply line in southwest Iran was struck overnight.

item.title: Airstrikes may have destroyed Iran's last F-14s, ending a long, strange saga
item.summary: The F-14 was made famous in Top Gun. The U.S. sold the planes to Iran in the 1970s, only for the two countries to become enemies. Iran kept its F-14s flying for decades in the face of U.S. sanctions.

item.title: Trump delivers farmers another financial blow with Iran war
item.summary: Some of President Trump's policies, the latest being the war in Iran, are testing his support among farmers who are being burdened with higher costs.

item.title: Kim vows to 'irreversibly' cement North Korea's nuclear status
item.summary: In his speech, Kim expressed pride in the country's rapid expansion of nuclear weapons and missiles in recent years, calling it the "right" choice.

item.title: At least 66 killed in military plane crash in Colombia, head of armed forces says
item.summary: Colombian officials say that a military cargo plane with 128 people on board, most of them soldiers, crashed shortly after taking off Monday in southwestern Colombia.

item.title: Before running for Congress, Bobby Pulido was a Tejano music icon
item.summary: Pulido has been a mainstay of Tejano music —a genre blending traditional regional Mexican elements with country, pop and conjunto influences — for more than three decades.

item.title: Denmark holds early elections spurred by Trump's threats to take Greenland
item.summary: Denmark's prime minister called early parliamentary elections after gaining a popularity boost from standing up to President Trump over his threat to seize Greenland.

item.title: Trump takes aim at windmills despite increasing energy costs
item.summary: President Trump's mission to fight renewable wind energy comes at a time of rising energy costs.

item.title: As parents age, their children face hard choices about when to take the car keys
item.summary: States have many policies to stop risky older drivers from renewing their licenses. But in practice, it's often adult children who must decide when to take the car keys away from an aging parent.

item.title: ICE deployments created chaos for cities and cost them millions, NPR analysis finds
item.summary: Local leaders report already-strapped police departments racked up overtime bills in the millions while others report a multi-million dollar hit to business during the worst ICE surges.
